about.what: Request templates for the calendar desk's production-scale stream. Each group was written by a separate writer who saw only a description of the assistant's job and of the placeholders, and neither the method under test nor any result. The words are kept exactly as each writer returned them.

writers.g1: A busy executive who dictates short, direct messages
writers.g2: An office manager who writes polite, complete sentences
writers.g3: A software engineer who writes terse shorthand
writers.g4: A chatty colleague who buries the request in context and small talk
writers.g5: A new team member who writes formally and over-explains
writers.g6: Someone typing fast on a phone between meetings
writers.exam: A project coordinator who forwards requests on behalf of other people
